subject: CAIQ delta sync & staged rollback playbook - Vendr profile maintenance
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ delta sync: Vendr profile maintenance and rollback window

Hey Camila / Ben,

We have a small CAIQ delta that needs to be reflected in our Vendr profile this Friday (9/03). Changes are scoped to five control answers (network segmentation, key rotation cadence, backup retention, logging endpoint, and SSO assertion lifetime). Security has signed off on the content, but we need a short operational playbook so Vendr proof possession and the vendor manifest align.

Please include the following in the playbook:
- planned sync window (2h preferred) and blackout periods
- preflight checks and hash verification approach for evidence files
- staged rollback / rollback trigger thresholds (what fails the sync)
- owner assignments and escalation contacts

Ben — can you confirm the manifest export (CSV) will include artifact hashes and S3 paths?
Camila — would you lead the Vendr coordination?

I attached the CAIQ delta snapshot for context.

Thanks,
Naomi

[Attachment: CAIQ-delta-snapshot-20270903.pdf (PDF, 1.8MB)]

Naomi Feldman

Redwood Inference
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-03T09:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ delta sync: Vendr profile maintenance and rollback window

Thanks Naomi — I'll take point and drafted a short playbook below. High level plan (can iterate):

1) Preflight (T-24 to T-2 hours)
   - Confirm CAIQ delta PDF and control mapping uploaded to S3 (secure bucket) and sign with KMS key; record SHA256 hashes.
   - Export Vendr manifest CSV with artifact paths + hashes and place in vendor SFTP / API staging location.
   - Run a dry-run validation against Vendr sandbox (manifest validation only).

2) Sync window (T0) — 2 hour window starting 10:00 PT 
   - Phase A (0-30m): push manifest to Vendr staging, validate ingestion response codes.
   - Phase B (30-90m): push evidence links and CAIQ answers update; monitor ingestion logs and 4xx/5xx rates.
   - Phase C (90-120m): final verification using Vendr API / UI; sample check 5 controls in production profile and confirm hashes match S3.

3) Rollback criteria & staged rollback (automated + manual)
   - Automated rollback if manifest ingestion returns >10% critical error rate OR any evidence file hash mismatch.
   - If automated rollback triggers: Vendr will be requested to revert to previous manifest (we keep snapshot on S3 with timestamped filenames).
   - Manual rollback: if sampling shows inconsistent answers across profile pages or external dependent checks fail (SSO assertions), initiate incident channel and schedule revert.

4) Owners / Escalation
   - Primary: Camila Reyes (vendor coord) camila@redwood.com
   - Secondary: Ben Carter (evidence export & hash) ben@redwood.com
   - Security approver: Naomi Feldman naomi@redwood.com
   - Vendr contact: Lena Ortiz lena@vendr.io

5) Post-sync artifacts
   - Upload final CAIQ-delta-report (PDF) and vendr-sync-manifest (CSV) to shared Drive and link in the ticket.
   - 24h validation pass to surface any regressions.

Questions for Ben: can the manifest include a KMS-signed checksum field and a per-artifact last-modified timestamp? If so, I will attach the manifest to the drive link and ping Vendr.

I'm attaching the CAIQ delta report and an example manifest template. Once Ben confirms the CSV fields, I'll coordinate the Vendr staging mechanism.

Attachments:
- CAIQ-delta-report-20270903.pdf
- vendr-sync-manifest-20270903.csv

--
Camila Reyes
Vendor Security Lead, Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Lena Ortiz <lena@vendr.io>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: David Cho <david.cho@cleardata.com>
Date: 2027-09-03T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ delta sync: Vendr profile maintenance and rollback window

Thanks Camila — Vendr can support the staged rollout and revert to prior manifest snapshots. A few clarifying notes from our ops team: 

1) Transport — we can accept the manifest via SFTP (service account) or our ingestion API. Which do you prefer?
2) Signed checksums — we can ingest a SHA256 field but cannot verify KMS signatures on our side unless you provide a verification token; simplest path is SHA256 + timestamp + pre-registered manifest ID.
3) Evidence links — S3 pre-signed URLs are fine for ingestion but must have a TTL >= 48 hours for post-sync sampling.

We'll reserve 10:00-12:00 PT for staging; please provide the CSV manifest and sample signed hash file by 09:30 PT so our sandbox validation can run. Also confirm the rollback API call format and the account authorized to call it (we'll whitelist camila@redwood.com and an Ops service account).

Attachments: none (please attach manifest and signed-hash file).

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Partner Ops — Vendr
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@vendr.io>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
